title: Takes 2-4 submit as one priced batch and appear as one strip
gap: use-composer.ts:397-433 submits takes in a loop. On the connected path, setRun/setConnectedJob are overwritten on each iteration, so only the last take is polled and filed although every take is charged. A price that moves mid-loop stops the loop after earlier takes have already been sent. On the workspace path no batchId/variation is sent, even though admission stores them (lib/generationAdmission.ts:1735-1741) and lib/variations.ts already groups batches into strips. submitConsumerGenerationBatchJobs (generation-service.ts:325: one approval for the summed price of 2-4 quoted jobs, then one paid call) is reachable only from the planner.
target: Connected: quote N jobs, and the button shows their sum ('Generate 4 takes · 72 cr'). Add a 'submit-batch' action to the existing /api/higgsfield/consumer/generation route that calls submitConsumerGenerationBatchJobs, and track every returned id in the jobs map. Workspace credits: send one batchId plus variation 1..N. Render Gen Results and Takes as lib/variations.ts strips labelled 'take 1-4'.
respects_rules: The summed price is on the button and is re-quoted on click. The existing batch service is reused rather than rebuilt.
